configNotes.en: Unofficial conversion trial: HTML layout and heading markup were changed, and one duplicated https:// prefix in the GNU Make jobserver link was repaired. Original authorship references are retained. No Japanese translation has been completed.

configNotes.en: The fixed upstream COPYING file is preserved verbatim, including its original “Version 2.0, January 2010” heading. It has not been silently replaced with another license text.
configNotes.ja: 固定した上流COPYINGを「Version 2.0, January 2010」という原文の見出しも含めてそのまま保存しています。別のライセンス本文に置き換えていません。
